title: U.S. House · California's 44th District
area: South Bay and harbor-area Los Angeles County, including San Pedro, Wilmington, Carson and parts of Long Beach, redrawn under Proposition 50 (approved November 2025).

context.text: Incumbent Nanette Barragán (D) and Republican Genevieve Angel advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary, defeating a Democratic write-in candidate.

candidates.name: Nanette Barragán
candidates.ballotNote: Advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary.

summary.text: Nanette Barragán is the Democratic incumbent seeking re-election in the 44th District. She previously served on the Hermosa Beach City Council, including as mayor pro tempore.

background.text: Earned a bachelor's degree from the University of California, Los Angeles in 2000 and a law degree from the University of Southern California in 2005.
Served on the Hermosa Beach City Council, including as mayor pro tempore, before her election to Congress.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce (Communications and Technology, Health, and Environment subcommittees) for the 2025-2026 term.
Chaired the House Homeland Security Committee's Border Security, Facilitation, and Operations Subcommittee during the 2021-2022 term.

candidates.researchNotes: No 2026-specific campaign website statements or Candidate Connection survey responses were found beyond committee-assignment history.

candidates.name: Genevieve Angel
candidates.ballotNote: Advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary.

summary.text: Genevieve Angel is the Republican candidate in the 44th District. She is a family nurse practitioner and healthcare executive running as a first-time candidate.

background.text: Earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Santo Tomas in 1992, a graduate degree from American International University in 2007, and a graduate degree from United States University in 2025.
Career experience includes working as a family nurse practitioner and healthcare executive.

priorities.text: Says she is focused on fiscal responsibility, public safety, healthcare reform and educational freedom.
priorities.quote: I bring a unique, hands-on perspective to the table. With a background as a Family Nurse Practitioner and healthcare executive, I'm committed to strengthening our community through fiscal responsibility, public safety, healthcare reform, and educational freedom.

positions.summary: Lists educational freedom among the policy areas she is personally passionate about, alongside economic affordability, public safety, healthcare reform and immigration reform.
